proverb_nastaliq: آب تِہ تۆتھ، باب تِہ تۆتھ
transliteration: Ab tih toth bab tih toth
english_translation: I love myself and I love my father.
meaning_english: A grasping disposition

english_translation: A knife in the water.
meaning_english: A traitor in the camp

english_translation: A big basket in the water.
meaning_english: An official who retains authority only so long as he retains his employment

proverb_nastaliq: اَچھ کٲنؠ جان تَہ وَتھ کٲنؠ نَہ
transliteration: Achh kóni ján tah wat káni nah
english_translation: Better that the eye be blind than that the way be blind.
meaning_english: He that goes a-borrowing goes a-sorrowing

english_translation: May your eyes be opened but see nothing.
meaning_english: A Kashmiri curse

english_translation: He'll take the (very) antimony out of your eyes (and you'll not know it).
meaning_english: A sharp fellow. Beware!

proverb_nastaliq: عَدَل تَہ وَدَل زَنانَہ چھےٚ پَشٕچ زَدَل ژھٔے
transliteration: Adal tah wadal zunánah chhai pashich zadal tshai
english_translation: A contrary woman is like bad grass on the roof.
meaning_english: Grass not fitted for thatching does not set well, but lets the rain through the roof

proverb_nastaliq: اَدِ دٔدِ یێژھِہ تَہ اَدِ دٔدِ رێژھِہ
transliteration: Adi dadi yětshih tah adi dadi rětshih
english_translation: Half (the people) are burnt with wishing and half are burnt with scandal.
meaning_english: The struggle for popularity and place

english_translation: Half at Lár and half at Dár. (or Dor)
meaning_english: A man of large and scattered property who cannot obtain anything from it

english_translation: A secret is (concealed) under the skin of man.
meaning_english: Man is a make-up of mystery

proverb_nastaliq: آگَہ بۆڈ پَہَرَس، نَوکَر بۆڈ وَہَرَس
transliteration: Ágah bod paharas noukar bod waharas
english_translation: The master is great in three hours, the servant is great in a year.
meaning_english: Some people earn as much in three hours as others do in twelve months

proverb_nastaliq: اَگَر چێس کَرِہ جَلد یِیِہ، اَگَر جَلد کَرِہ ژیر یِیِہ
transliteration: Agar tser karih jald yiyih, agar jald karih tsír yiyih
english_translation: If he delays he will come quickly, but if he hastens he will come slowly.
meaning_english: More haste, worse speed

english_translation: A man loves his own fault.
meaning_english: People are blind to their own defects

proverb_nastaliq: اَکھ گۆو جانی یار، بیٛاکھ گۆو نانی یار
transliteration: Ak gav jáni yár, byák gav náni yár
english_translation: One is a thorough friend, another is a 'loafer'. (Náni yár, a bread friend).
meaning_english: Distinguishes between true devoted friends and bread-friends

english_translation: One and one are eleven.
meaning_english: Two heads are better than one

proverb_nastaliq: اَکِس چھےٚ دَزان دار تَہ بیٛاکھ چُھس وُشنٛاوَن اَتھَہ
transliteration: Akis chhěh dazán dár tah byák chhus wushanawán athah
english_translation: One man's beard is on fire, and another man warms his hands by it.
meaning_english: To be glad at another's misfortune

proverb_nastaliq: اَکِس گۆم زَہ، میٖتر گٲیم شؠتھٕر، کاوَس گٲیم کوکِل
transliteration: Akis gom zah; měthar gúm shěthar; kawas gáyam kukil
english_translation: One became two; friends became enemies; the crow became a dove.
meaning_english: An old man's answer to a friend enquiring how he was

proverb_nastaliq: اَلکٲنؠ نِ داندَہ ہَوَر؛ اَکھ نَہ اَژَن گَرَہ، تَہ بیٛاکھ نَہ نیران بَرَہ
transliteration: Alikúnini dúndah hawar; ak nah atsan garah, tah byák nah nerán barah
english_translation: One-eyed 'Alí's yoke of oxen, -one will not enter the house, and the other will not come out of it.
meaning_english: A poor man with a refractory family

english_translation: Employment is like dirt upon the wrist.
meaning_english: Employment is uncertain; like dirt upon the wrist, it quickly comes and goes

proverb_nastaliq: اَنِم سۄے، وَوُم سۄے، لٔجِم سۄے پانَسٔے
transliteration: Anim sui, wavum suí, lajum suí pánasui
english_translation: I brought the nettle, I sowed the nettle, and then the nettle stung me.
meaning_english: Ingratitude

english_translation: An one-eyed woman is beautiful among blind women.
meaning_english: In the kingdom of the blind, the one-eyed is queen/king

proverb_nastaliq: آسَس مَزَہ تَہ یَد دَزَہ دَزَہ
english_translation: A taste in the mouth and a burning in the stomach.
meaning_english: Just enough to whet the appetite

proverb_nastaliq: آسُن چُھہ ہیٚچھِناوَن، نَہ آسُن چُھہ مَنٛدَچھاوَن
transliteration: Ásun chhuh hěchhinówán nah ásun chhuh mandachháwán
english_translation: To be (wealthy) teaches, not to be (wealthy) makes ashamed.
meaning_english: Wealth gives status and confidence to learn social graces; poverty restricts and shames

english_translation: As soon as the hands were washed friendship ran away.
meaning_english: Fair-weather friendship that ends as soon as the meal is over

proverb_nastaliq: اَتھَن ؤریَن پۆکھ نَد، شؠٹھَن ؤریَن پۆکھ سرؠہ
transliteration: Athan waryan puch nad, shethan waryan puk srěh
english_translation: For eight years the river ran, and for sixty years (after the waters had disappeared) the ground remained damp.
meaning_english: Men die but their deeds live

proverb_nastaliq: بابَہ آدَمَس زایِہ زٕ گَبٕر، اَکِ رۆٹ سْوَرَنِہ بیٚیِہ رۆٹ قَبِر
transliteration: Bābah Ādamas zāyih zə gabər, aki rot swaranih beyih rot qabr
english_translation: Father Adam had two sons. One was burnt and the other was buried (i.e., one became a Hindú and the other became a Muhammedan).
meaning_english: Universal shared ancestry transcending religious rites

english_translation: O father, become old and serve me.
meaning_english: Filial ingratitude and exploitation of elderly parents

proverb_nastaliq: بابَہ مَتٛیۆو تَہ دیٚڈ تِہ مَتٕیِہ
transliteration: Bābah matyov tah děd tih mateyih
english_translation: The father has become mad and the mother also has become mad.
meaning_english: Universal chaos or state of total disorder in leadership

english_translation: A child's pain is a hundred thousand pains.
meaning_english: Immense parental agony over a child's suffering

proverb_nastaliq: بَدَس سِر باوُن چُھہ بیٚبِہ اَنٛدَر سَرُف رَچھُن
transliteration: Badas sir bawun chhuh běbih andar saruf rachhun
english_translation: A wicked man may as well place a snake in his bosom as tell out his secrets.
meaning_english: Revealing sensitive confidences to malicious people invites betrayal

english_translation: Bahlol, a ragged habit, and an alms-bowl.
meaning_english: A very poor man

english_translation: Understanding is butler to success.
meaning_english: Wisdom and discernment are necessary to manage and preserve good fortune

proverb_nastaliq: بانَہ حَتَس دِزِہ تھانَہ حَت، تَہ آسَہ حَتَس کَیاہ دِزِہ؟
transliteration: Bānah hatas dizih thānah hat, tah āsah hatas kyāh dizih?
english_translation: A hundred covers for a hundred vessels, but what shall be given to stop a hundred mouths?
meaning_english: It is impossible to suppress public gossip and neighborhood rumor

english_translation: Who is your friend? Your pocket.
meaning_english: Material independence is the most reliable companion in trouble

english_translation: The ass shuts the door and dances.
meaning_english: A coward who boasts loudly at home but fears public scrutiny

english_translation: To behead another with hospitality.
meaning_english: Disarming an enemy through lavish generosity and kindness

english_translation: As garlic upon the hearth of a Pandit.
meaning_english: An extremely offensive, taboo, or unwelcome intrusion

english_translation: The Pandit died from hesitation.
meaning_english: Paralysis through analysis or superstition brings ruin

english_translation: One Pandit with another Pandit is like a mountain-crow.
meaning_english: Strong communal solidarity when any member faces distress

proverb_nastaliq: بؠکَل نَہ کانٛہہ تَہ گَرٕ پَتھَہ کاہ کاہ
transliteration: Be-akl nah kanh tah garah patah kah kah
english_translation: Not one ignorant man? Why there are eleven in every house!
meaning_english: Ignorance is widespread though universally denied

english_translation: Two brothers-in-law killed a lion between them.
meaning_english: Even traditional rivals can overcome formidable obstacles through unity

english_translation: Will the grocer sit and weigh water?
meaning_english: Undertaking an absurd and completely unproductive pursuit

english_translation: Be as the deaf man hearing and the blind man seeing.
meaning_english: Tactical discretion; noticing everything while keeping quiet

english_translation: To beat the cat.
meaning_english: Disciplining a scapegoat to intimidate others into submission

english_translation: Burnt bread for the hungry and the bare ground for sleep.
meaning_english: Extreme need removes all choosiness; necessity is easily satisfied

proverb_nastaliq: بوٗجِہ لٔبیَو کُلِہ تَل ژوٗنٛتھ، اَدَہ گٔیِہ پھُٹ ہؠتھ
transliteration: Bujih labyav kujih tal tsunt; adah gayih phut hit
english_translation: An old woman found an apple under the tree, and afterwards she always went with a basket.
meaning_english: Expecting a rare stroke of luck to repeat as a guaranteed entitlement

proverb_nastaliq: چٲے کَم یا یِژھ، لێکِن تَتس
transliteration: Chái kam yú yits lekin tats
english_translation: It does not matter whether the tea is less or more, but it must be hot.
meaning_english: Sincerity, warmth, and quality matter far more than sheer quantity

proverb_nastaliq: چُھو یِت بَتَہ تَہ دو یِت کَتھَہ
transliteration: Chhuv yit batah tah dúv yit kathah
english_translation: When it boils dinner is ready, and when opportunity offers speak and act.
meaning_english: Timing is everything; act and speak only when the right opportunity arrives

english_translation: Empty vessels sound.
meaning_english: People of shallow knowledge and little merit make the most boastful noise

proverb_nastaliq: دَچھُن اَتھَہ چُھہ چھَلان کھۆوَرس، تَہ کھۆوُر اَتھَہ چُھہ چھَلان دَچھنِس
transliteration: Dachhun atkah chhuh chhalún khowaris, tah khowur alhah chhuh chhalún dachhinis
english_translation: The right hand washes the left, and the left hand washes the right.
meaning_english: Mutual assistance and cooperation are essential for all human endeavors

english_translation: Ten wives but eleven dispositions.
meaning_english: Endless clashes and incompatible temperaments in an organization or home

proverb_nastaliq: دَہ گَز ہؠوُر کَیاہ تَہ دَہ گَز بُن کَیاہ؟
transliteration: Dah gaz hyur kyāh tah dah gaz bun kyāh?
english_translation: What is the difference whether it is ten yards up or ten yards down?
meaning_english: Blindly applying a method with zero common sense or contextual awareness

proverb_nastaliq: دَی اَی دِیِہ تَہ بَرَس نؠرَسَی، دَی نَی دِیِہ تَہ کروٗہَس ساسَہ ژٔٹِتھ کَیاہ؟
transliteration: Dai ai diyih tah barah nyásai; Dai nai diyih tah krúhah sásah tsatit kyah?
english_translation: If God intends to give, He will give at the door; but if God will not give, then what is the good of going a thousand kos for it.
meaning_english: Divine providence cannot be forced by anxious distant travel

proverb_nastaliq: دانا دُشمَن چُھہ نادان مؠتھرَس خۄتَہ جان
transliteration: Dáná dushman chhui nádán metharah sandih khutah ján
english_translation: A wise enemy is better than an unwise friend.
meaning_english: An ignorant friend causes greater ruin through foolishness than a smart enemy

english_translation: Are the horns too heavy for the bullock? (No).
meaning_english: A parent never considers their own offspring a burden

english_translation: A good handful of grass for the bullock, but six handfuls for the calf.
meaning_english: Gross injustice in rewarding idle favorites over hard workers

proverb_nastaliq: دَپَہَس اَی آبَس گَژھُن گَژھِہ خُشکَس، دَپَہَس اَی خُشکَس گَژھُن گَژھِہ آبَس
transliteration: Dapahas ai ábas gatshun gatshih khushkas; Dapahas ai khushkas gatshun gatshih ábas
english_translation: If I tell him to go to the water he will go to the land; if I tell him to go to the land he will go to the water.
meaning_english: A completely contrary or muddle-headed servant who does everything backwards

english_translation: To count the waves of the river.
meaning_english: An impossible enterprise turned into an opportunistic triumph

proverb_nastaliq: دَستارَن چُھہ نَہ موٗل، دَربارَن چُھہ
transliteration: Dastúran chhuh nah mul, darbóran chhuh
english_translation: No worth is attached to turbans, but to professions.
meaning_english: Merit and competence matter, not decorative titles or attire

english_translation: The great melá is at Digám, but the washing of the mound is at Nadigám.
meaning_english: Misdirected energy or performing ceremonies in the wrong quarter

proverb_nastaliq: دِل با دِل گۆو آئینہٕ، یُتھ وُچھَم تِتھ وُچھے
transliteration: Dil ba dil gav áinah; yut wuchham, tyut wuchhai
english_translation: Your heart and mine are like a looking-glass; as you see me, so I shall appear to you.
meaning_english: Relationships operate on pure mutual reciprocity and emotional reflection

proverb_nastaliq: دۄد نا تَہ دَگ نَی کَوَہ یِیَم اوٗشؠ؟
transliteration: Dod nah tah dag nai kawah yiyam ushye?
english_translation: I have neither pain nor smart, why should I cry?
meaning_english: Refusing to grieve or fret over problems that do not concern one

proverb_nastaliq: دۄگ دِتھ تِہ بارَو، دۄگ ہؠتھ تِہ بارَو
transliteration: Dog dit tih bárav; dog het tih bárav
english_translation: Whether he strikes another, or whether he himself is struck, it's all the same—he grumbles.
meaning_english: A chronic malcontent who complains under every possible outcome

proverb_nastaliq: دۄن باژَن ہٕنٛز ہَر گٔیِہ وَہراتس ہُند روٗد
transliteration: Don bútsan hunz har gayih wahráts hund rúd
english_translation: Strife between husband and wife is like the monsoon rains.
meaning_english: Intense and noisy domestic disputes that clear up just as quickly

english_translation: One snaps with two fingers (not with one).
meaning_english: It takes two individuals to create conflict; blame is rarely unilateral

english_translation: Clapping is with both hands.
meaning_english: Cooperation and conflict alike require engagement from two sides

proverb_nastaliq: دراگ ژَلِہ تَہ داگ ژَلِہ نَہ
transliteration: Drúg tsalih tah dúg tsalih nah
english_translation: The famine will disappear, but the stains will not disappear.
meaning_english: Scarcity ends, but dishonor and trauma leave permanent scars

english_translation: (Like) a marble against a dumat.
meaning_english: Wasting sage advice on a fool; words bounce off with zero effect

proverb_nastaliq: دوٗرِہ دوٗرِہ چُھہ مَنَژ میۆٹھ، نَکھَہ نَکھَہ چُھہ قَند تیۆٹھ
transliteration: Dúrih, dúríh chhuh manats methún; nakhah, nakhah chhuh kand tethan
english_translation: From a distance black pepper is sweet; near at hand sugar is bitter.
meaning_english: Distance creates false allure, while constant familiarity breeds contempt

proverb_nastaliq: دُشمَنَہ سٕنٛدِہ لَگِہ نَہ کٔنِہ ژَنٛجِہ، دوستَہ سٕنٛدِہ لَگِہ پوشِہ ژَنٛجِہ
transliteration: Dushmanah sandih lagih nah kanih tsanjih; dostah sandih lagih poshih tsanjih
english_translation: The slap of the hand from an enemy will not hurt, but the angry touch, even with a flower, from a friend, will wound.
meaning_english: Injuries from foes are easily borne; rebukes from beloved friends cut deeply

proverb_nastaliq: دیارَہ وول چُھہ نَہ بۆڈ، بَتَہ وول چُھہ بۆڈ
transliteration: Dyarahwol chhuh nah bod; batahwol chhuh bod
english_translation: Not the rich man, but the man who gives dinners, is great.
meaning_english: True greatness lies in generous hospitality, not in hoarded wealth

english_translation: A sheep in appearance, but a wolf at heart.
meaning_english: A deceitful hypocrite whose gentle appearance hides cruel intentions

proverb_nastaliq: گاڈ چھےٚ دَریاوَس اَنٛدَر تریشِہ باپَتھ مَران
transliteration: Gád chhěh daryávas andar treshih búpat marán
english_translation: The fish dies from thirst in the river.
meaning_english: Failing or starving despite being surrounded by total abundance

english_translation: The rat nonplusses the cat.
meaning_english: A small, oppressed person cleverly outmaneuvering a powerful oppressor

proverb_nastaliq: گَگُر وَژھِہ نَہ پَنٕنِہ وِج، پَتَہ ہؠتھ مٲج
transliteration: Gagur wětsih nah pananih wúj, patah het múj
english_translation: The rat himself cannot get into his nest properly, and yet he takes his mother after him!
meaning_english: Scarcely able to support oneself, yet taking on extra dependents

proverb_nastaliq: گام چُھہ خام، شَہْر چُھہ مانِنٛدِ بَحَر
transliteration: Gám chhuh khám; shahr chhuh múnindi bahar
english_translation: The village is kachcha (i.e., not the place to get anything); the city is like a river (there everything goes on swimmingly).
meaning_english: Rural subsistence contrasts with the abundance and trade of the city

proverb_nastaliq: گامُک سُہ تَہ شَہْرُک ہُوٗن چُھہ بَرابَر
transliteration: Gámuk suh tah shahruk hún chhuh barábar
english_translation: A village tiger and a city dog are equal.
meaning_english: A simple city dweller possesses wits matching a prominent rural leader

english_translation: Shall one house give answer to the whole village?
meaning_english: An isolated person cannot dispute against a united consensus

english_translation: Ganges in the house.
meaning_english: Finding supreme blessing, virtue, or fortune right at one's doorstep

proverb_nastaliq: گَرِہ پؠٹھ زامُتھُر، بَرِہ پؠٹھ ہُوٗن
transliteration: Gar peth zámuthur bar peth hún
english_translation: A son-in-law who lives always in his father-in-law's house, is like a dog at the door.
meaning_english: Loss of dignity when living dependent on a father-in-law's charity

proverb_nastaliq: گَرہ وَنٛدَے گَرہ ساسَہ، گَرہ نیرَہَہ نَہ زانٛہہ
transliteration: Garah wandai garah sásá garah nerahah nah zah
english_translation: O home, I offer you a thousand houses, and I will never go out from you.
meaning_english: The ultimate expression of domestic contentment and love for home

english_translation: Darkness in the home, but a light in the mosque.
meaning_english: Ostentatious public charity while neglecting one's own family

proverb_nastaliq: گاوِ چُھہ وَنَمُت ہَتِہ کِنِہ دِتَم تَہ لَٹِہ کِنِہ دِمَے
transliteration: Gáwih chhuh wonamut hatih kini ditam tah lațih kini dimai
english_translation: The cow said, 'Give to me by the throat (i.e., feed me) and I will give to you by the tail' (i.e., I will supply you with milk, ghí, and butter).
meaning_english: Feed a servant or an animal well and they will serve you well

proverb_nastaliq: گُرِین لاگِکھ نال تَہ خَر گٔے پادَر دٲرِتھ
transliteration: Gurin lágík náe tah khar gai padar dúrit
english_translation: The horses got shod, and the donkeys put out their hoofs (for shoeing).
meaning_english: Unqualified people demanding the same honors and privileges as superiors

proverb_nastaliq: گُرِس مَول تَہ ژُڈ ہؠتھ پَتھ کَنِہ
transliteration: Gursas mál tah tsud het patah kani
english_translation: Wishing to drink the butter-milk, but hiding the vessel behind him.
meaning_english: False modesty or coyness when secretly desiring a favor

proverb_nastaliq: حَکِیمَس تَہ حاکِمَس نِشِہ رَچھتَم خُدایو
transliteration: Hakimas tah hákimas nishih rachhtam Khudayo
english_translation: O God, deliver me from the doctor and the ruler.
meaning_english: Seeking protection from both disease and judicial oppression

english_translation: A bear's friendship.
meaning_english: A foolish ally whose clumsy assistance brings ruin or death

proverb_nastaliq: ہَردُک گُرُس میٖترَس، سۆنتُک گُرُس شؠترَس
transliteration: Hardah gurus mētras, sontah gurus shětras
english_translation: Autumn butter-milk for the friend, and spring butter-milk for the enemy.
meaning_english: Offering prime quality to loved ones and thin leftovers to adversaries

english_translation: A witness against (my) words but a sharer in (my) mouthful.
meaning_english: An opportunist hedging bets across mutually exclusive ventures

proverb_nastaliq: ہٲرؠ اَم ہۆزرَہ کٔنِتھ، ژےٚ چُھی سۆد ہۆزَرنہٕ یِوان
transliteration: Hárih aní búzarah kanit tsěh chhuí syud bozanah yiwán
english_translation: You think him a righteous man, but he would sell you for a cowrie in the market.
meaning_english: Adding insult to injury through ruthless extortion after massive sacrifice

english_translation: Gradually from chippings a mountain is made.
meaning_english: Small steady efforts and savings accumulate into vast achievements

english_translation: The jogi of Haramukh.
meaning_english: Laboring tirelessly without making any permanent progress; absent-mindedness

proverb_nastaliq: ہاش تِہ بَد تَہ نوش تِہ بَد، لێج دَز تَہ والِہ کُس؟
transliteration: Hash tih bad tah nosh tih bad lěj duz tah walih kus?
english_translation: The mother-in-law is great, the daughter-in-law is also great; the pot is burnt, who will take it off the fire?
meaning_english: False dignity and domestic rivalry causing collective loss

proverb_nastaliq: ہۄنٛد مَرُن کِہ نَہ کَتھ، لَلِہ نَلوَٹ ژَلِہ نَہ زانٛہہ
transliteration: Hond marún kih nah kat, Lalih nalawat tsalih nah zah
english_translation: Whether they killed a big sheep or a small one, it was all the same, Lal always had the nalawat in her plate.
meaning_english: Unchanging oppression and unfair treatment regardless of external abundance

english_translation: A string of pearls to a dog.
meaning_english: Casting pearls before swine; wasting refinement on the uncouth

english_translation: Tobacco from Jahám (i.e., splendid tobacco).
meaning_english: Jahám tobacco is said to be the finest in the valley

proverb_nastaliq: جَنگَس مَنٛز چھےٚ تھیٖل تِہ تَہ گولِہ تِہ
transliteration: Jangas manz chhai thíl tih tah gúli tih
english_translation: You get purse and bullet, too, from fighting; (therefore think over the matter before you enter the lists).
meaning_english: Every high-reward venture carries equal hazard and mortal risk

english_translation: Honour is inside your mouth. Take heed to your words.
meaning_english: Personal dignity and safety are preserved solely by guarding the tongue

english_translation: Eleven men have lost a cow between them.
meaning_english: A shared misfortune is lighter and easier to bear

english_translation: Eleven roads to eleven men.
meaning_english: Total disunity and absence of leadership where everyone goes their own way

english_translation: Destruction to pride.
meaning_english: Pride goes before destruction; arrogance precipitates total ruin

english_translation: Coming and going are alike to him.
meaning_english: A happy-go-lucky individual

english_translation: Begging and riding upon a horse !
meaning_english: A proud beggar

english_translation: Picking thorns or bones out of the milk.
meaning_english: An overscrupulous Brahman

english_translation: A sheep also can lift his tail.
meaning_english: The smallest worm will turn being trodden upon

english_translation: Kamadev has smoothed that man's face with his hands.
meaning_english: Cited on seeing any beautiful man or woman

english_translation: To serve a mean man is like beating the earth (i.e., it is a profitless work).
meaning_english: Serving a base person is profitless labor

english_translation: To bring cotton from the ear.
meaning_english: Impossible; attempting to do things in an impossible way

proverb_nastaliq: کَنَہ ڈۆل چُھے بۆٹَنِ سۄدَس بَرابَر
english_translation: A man who turns away his ear (from scandal, &c.), is like the Botan or Ladak trade (i.e., receives great profit).
meaning_english: Receives great profit by turning away from scandal

proverb_nastaliq: مام تھاوِہ عِزَت تَہ گام تِہ تھاوِہ عِزَت
transliteration: Mam thawih izzat tah gam tih thawih izzat
english_translation: If an uncle honours (a man) the village will also honour (him).
meaning_english: A smile from those in authority is worth much

english_translation: To ask (a favour) is to die (i.e., you put yourself under an obligation—you lose your independence).
meaning_english: Asking favours puts you under obligation and destroys independence

proverb_nastaliq: مَنٛز گٔنؠ مَنٛزٔمِس، کَلَہ سَردارَس، لَٹ گُناہگارَس تَہ بیٚچارَس
transliteration: Manz gani manzamis; kalah sardaras; lat gunahgaras tah becharas
english_translation: The middle portion (of the fish) for the middle-class man; the head for the host; and the tail for the sinner and the helpless.
meaning_english: Portions distributed by social standing

english_translation: Only pashmina has softness.
meaning_english: Genuine quality cannot be simulated

english_translation: The fruit-tree is bending.
meaning_english: True wisdom produces humility

english_translation: The pir is not great, faith is great.
meaning_english: Faith achieves results rather than outward intermediaries

proverb_nastaliq: سْرۆگُے چُھہ درۆگ، تَہ درۆگُے چُھہ سْرۆگ
transliteration: Srugui chhuh drug tah drugui chhuh srug
english_translation: Cheap is dear and dear is cheap.
meaning_english: Inferior cheap goods incur recurring costs

english_translation: Seeing, yet blind, and hearing, yet deaf.
meaning_english: Exercising tactical discretion by staying silent

english_translation: A man from another district is a thiever of fowls.
meaning_english: Blaming outsiders for neighborhood mishaps

english_translation: A dog following after a fasting man.
meaning_english: One trouble after another

english_translation: A man should stretch out his feet after looking at the bedclothes.
meaning_english: Cut your coat according to your cloth; live strictly within your means
